channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams announces Service-Managed Partition Keys for simplified data ingestion
item.description: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports service-managed partition keys for On-Demand Standard and On-Demand Advantage streams, automatically distributing records across shards without requiring customers to specify partition keys to… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports Salesforce and Zendesk as native data source connectors
item.description: AWS announces Salesforce and Zendesk data source connectors for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, a fully managed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) service. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now provides routing step data in the analytics data lake
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now provides routing step data in the analytics data lake, making it easier for customers to generate insights from routing decisions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EMR on EKS now supports IPv6 Amazon EKS clusters
item.description: Today, AWS announces that Amazon EMR on EKS now supports running workloads on IPv6 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) clusters. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region strong consistency now supports additional AWS Regions and cross-continent configurations
item.description: Starting today, Amazon DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region strong consistency (MRSC) is available in five additional AWS Regions: Canada (Central), Europe (Stockholm), Europe (Spain), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), and Asia Pacific… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Cuts 100 TB of Memory from 1.1.1.1 DNS Cache
item.description: Cloudflare redesigned the in-memory representation of its Big Pineapple DNS cache, reducing the per-entry footprint by 56% and freeing roughly 100 TB of working-set memory across its fleet. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Security Hub AI Inventory adds Azure self-hosted instance support
item.description: AWS Security Hub AI Inventory now supports discovering and cataloging AI assets running on self-hosted instances in Microsoft Azure. (1 source: aws)
